long_biography.plain_text:
V. Suárez & Co. distributes drinks, food and consumer goods across Puerto Rico under Diego Suárez Jr.'s leadership. His grandfather Vicente founded the business; his father Diego Suárez Sánchez directed its expansion and prepared a family succession. The younger Suárez now chairs the company as chief executive. Its distribution network spans alcoholic and soft drinks, dry provisions and refrigerated products.

Before joining the family firm, Suárez studied management and marketing at the University of Miami and held sales roles with drinks companies. The group subsequently invested in Campofresco, adding juice and beverage manufacturing to its distribution base. Suárez also represented the company in establishing a university scholarship endowment for Puerto Rican students with financial need.

Before joining the family firm, Suárez studied management and marketing at the University of Miami and held sales roles with drinks companies. The group subsequently invested in Campofresco, adding juice and beverage manufacturing to its distribution base.
